findings.finding: Connected Nations Spring 2026 is a January 2026 snapshot of fixed-line and fixed-wireless availability; do not mix with later delivery/contract context.
Planned Network Deployments 2026 is forward-looking to end-2028/January-2029 and supplements rather than replaces the January 2026 current snapshot.
PND High Confidence means at least Low Level Design Complete plus committed funding; it is not current service availability.
June 2026 premises release uses January 2026 OMR; current_gigabit can be FALSE for connections delivered after the OMR and supplier-return gaps exist.
future_gigabit uses BDUK OMR only and is not directly comparable with Ofcom PND because premise bases, supplier sets, methods and dates differ.
July 2026 contract tables are initial-scope only, snapshot 16 July, subject to ingestion lag and rounded to nearest 10; not parcel-level service truth.
Online ONSPD Live represents live-postcode digital vector centroids as at May 2026; it is geography identity support only.
ONSPD May 2026 contains current and terminated postcodes and supports geography linkage; it is not broadband measurement.
